content: Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ nɛɛ, sɑ̃ɑ yerun yɑɑrɑ sɔɔkɑɑn kɔnnɔ ɡe ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ, ɡɑ ko n kɛnuɑwɑ sɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ tiɑ yè sɔɔ bɑ rɑ sɔmburu ko. Adɑmɑ bɑ koo ɡu kɛniɑwɑ tɔ̃ɔ wɛ̃rɑruɡiru sɔɔ kɑ sere mɑɑ suru kpɑo ù n yɑrɑ.

Isirelibɑn kpɑro u koo duwɑ sɑɑ kɔnnɔ ɡe ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ tɔɔwɔn di kpɑ u nɑ u yɔ̃rɑ kɔnnɔ ɡen kɑdirin bɔkuɔ sɑnɑm mɛ yɑ̃ku kowobu bɑ nùn yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡiru kɑ siɑrɑbun yɑ̃kuru kuɑmmɛ. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, u ko n yiirewɑ kɔnnɔ ɡen mi. Yen biru kpɑ u yɑri. Bɑ ǹ kɔnnɔ ɡe kɛnumɔ sere yokɑ.
Isirelibɑ bɑ koo nɑ bu kpunɑwɑ bu Yinni Gusunɔ bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃ kɔnnɔ ɡen mi tɔ̃ɔ wɛ̃rɑruɡiru sɔɔ kɑ sere mɑɑ suru kpɑo bɑɑwure sɔɔ.
Tɔ̃ɔ wɛ̃rɑruɡii te sɔɔ, sinɑ boko u koo yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡiru ko kɑ yɑ̃ɑ kpɛmminu nɔɔbɑ tiɑ kɑ sere mɑɑ yɑ̃ɑ kinɛ teeru. Ni kpuro nu kun ɑlebu ɡɑɑ mɔ.
U koo mɑɑ ɑlikɑmɑn som kilo tɛnɑ sɔndi yɑ̃ɑ kinɛru bɑɑteren wɔllɔ kɑ sere mɑɑ ɡum ditiri nɔɔbɑ tiɑ som mɛn wɔllɔ. Som mɛ u kĩwɑ u koo sɔndi yɑ̃ɑ kpɛmminu wɔllɔ.
Suru kpɑo ù n yɑrɑ, u koo nɑɑ kinɛ kpɛndu ɡowɑ te tɑ ǹ ɑlebu mɔ kɑ yɑ̃ɑ kpɛmminu nɔɔbɑ tiɑ kɑ yɑ̃ɑ kinɛ teeru, ni kpuro nu kun ɑlebu mɔ.
Mɛyɑ u koo mɑɑ ɑlikɑmɑn som kilo tɛnɑ sɔndi nɑɑ kinɛru bɑɑteren wɔllɔ kɑ yɑ̃ɑ kinɛru bɑɑteren wɔllɔ. U koo ɡum ditiri nɔɔbɑ tiɑ doke som mɛ sɔɔ kpɑ u yɑ̃ɑ kpɛmmii nin wɔllɔ som sɔndi mɛ u kĩ.
Ben kpɑro u koo duwɑ sɑɑ dii yɑɑrɑn kɔnnɔn di. Min diyɑ u koo mɑɑ kɑ yɑri.

Adɑmɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ̀ n mɑn sɑ̃ɑru nɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru ɡɑru sɔɔ, be bɑ duɑ sɑɑ kɔnnɔ ɡe ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑn di, bɑ koo yɑriwɑ kɑ kɔnnɔ ɡe ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ. Be bɑ mɑɑ duɑ sɑɑ kɔnnɔ ɡe ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑn di, bɑ koo yɑriwɑ kɑ kɔnnɔ ɡe ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ. Goo kun yɑriɔ kɔnnɔ ɡe u kɑ duɑn di.
Ben kpɑro u koo du sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ duɔ kpɑ u yɑri sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ yɑriɔ.
Yɑ̃kunun woodɑ

Tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑnun sɑnɑm, bɑ̀ n yɑ̃kuru mɔ̀ kɑ nɑɑ kinɛru kɑ yɑ̃ɑ kinɛru, ɑlikɑmɑn som kilo tɛnɑ bɑ ko n dɑ sɔndi sɑbe nin bɑɑteren wɔllɔ kɑ ɡum ditiri nɔɔbɑ tiɑ. Adɑmɑ ǹ n yɑ̃ɑ kinɛ kpɛndun nɑ bɑ kɑ mɔ̀, som mɛ̀n nɔɔ bɑ kĩwɑ bɑ koo kɑ nɑ.

Ben kpɑro ù n ɡɔ̃ru doke u yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡiru ǹ kun mɛ siɑrɑbun yɑ̃kuru ko, bɑ ko n dɑ nùn kɔnnɔ ɡe ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ kɛniɛwɑ. U koo tu kowɑ nɡe mɛ u rɑ ko tɔ̃ɔ wɛ̃rɑruɡiru sɔɔ. Ù n yɑrɑ u doonɑ kpɑ bu kɔnnɔ ɡe kɛnɛ.
Tɔ̃ɔ bɑɑtere bɑ ko n dɑ Yinni Gusunɔ yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡiru kuewɑ kɑ yɑ̃ɑru wɔ̃ɔ tiɑɡiru te tɑ ǹ ɑlebu ɡɑɑ mɔ. Bɑ ko n dɑ tu kowɑ bururu bɑɑtere.
Bururu bɑɑtere, bɑ ko n dɑ yɑ̃kuru kowɑ kɑ som kilo nɔɔbu ye bɑ burinɑ kɑ ɡum ditiri yiru. Mɛyɑ bɑ ko n dɑ tu ko tɔ̃ɔ bɑɑtere sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ bururu bɑɑtere bɑ ko n dɑ Yinni Gusunɔ yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡiru kue kɑ yɑ̃ɑ kinɛ kpɛndu kɑ som kɑ sere mɑɑ ɡum. Mɛyɑ bɑ ko n dɑ tu ko sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Ye n sɑ̃ɑ Isirelibɑn kpɑron
bibuɡiɑ
Amɛniwɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡeruɑ. Nɑ nɛɛ, Isirelibɑn kpɑro ù n win bibun turo tem kɑ̃, tem mɛ, mu koo kowɑ bii win bibun bweseruɡim.
Adɑmɑ ù n win yoo tem kɑ̃, yɑkiɑbun wɔ̃ɔ ɡɑ̀ n turɑ yoo wi, u ǹ ko n mɑɑ tem mɛ mɔ. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, mu koo kowɑ wi, kpɑro wiɡim. Win bibu tɔnɑwɑ bɑ koo kpĩ bu win tem tubi di.
Kpɑro wi, u ku rɑɑ win tɔmbu tem mwɑɑri. Ye u koo win bibu wɛ̃ kpuro u de yɑ n wee win mɔrun di. Kpɑ nɛn tɔmbu sɔɔ ɡoo u ku rɑɑ kɑ win tem biɑ.
Sɑ̃ɑ yerun doo koo yeru
Durɔ wi, u kɑ Esekiɛli dɑ dirɔ te tɑ wɑ̃ɑ yɑ̃ku kowobun sɔ̃ sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ. U duɑ sɑɑ kɔnnɔ ɡe ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑn di. Yen sɔɔ mi, ɑyeru ɡɑrɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru ɡiɑ.

Mɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑye te, tɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ mi yɑ̃ku kowobu bɑ ko n dɑ torɑnun yɑ̃ku yɑɑ yike kpɑ bu som mɛ bɑ kɑ yɑ̃kunu kuɑ sɔmɛ. Nɡe mɛyɑ bɑ ǹ mɑɑ kɑ yi dɔɔ tɔɔwɔ Isirelibɑ bu sere ye bɑbiri. Domi yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Yinni Gusunɔɡiɑ.
Yen biru u mɑɑ kɑ nùn dɑ yɑɑrɑ tɔɔkɑɑɔ. Mɑ bɑ dɑ yen ɡoonu nnɛ ye kpuron mi. Mɑ u deemɑ bɑ bɑtumɑ ɡɑɑ wĩɑ ɡoo ten bɑɑteren mi.
Bɑtumɑ yen bɑɑyeren dɛ̃ɛbu bu sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡɔm soonu weeru mɑ yen yɑsum mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ ɡɔm soonu tɛnɑ. Ye nnɛ ye kpuro yɑ nɛwɑ.
Bɑ ɡɑnɑ kuɑ bɑ kɑ ye nnɛ ye kpuro sikerenɑ. Mɑ bɑ dosu ɡirɑ ɡɑnɑ ye sɔɔ.
Mɑ durɔ wi, u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ mi sɑ̃ɑ yee ten sɔm kowobu bɑ ko n dɑ yɑɑ yike ye tɔmbɑ kɑ yɑ̃kuru nɑ.
Dɑɑ te tɑ yɑrimɔ
sɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun di
